scope: 87 current quality-held profiles; 3 legacy redirects excluded and preserved
researchTool: Local Crawl4AI HTTP service 0.5.1-d1, check_robots_txt enabled; cached bounded crawling plus public source discovery
limits: All 87 original held records received external discovery attempts after follow-up: 79 initial name/location searches, two later phone-only searches for ambiguous names, and six direct linked-site crawls without an initial search. Eight phone searches and eight additional identity searches were performed in the follow-up. Crawl4AI checked candidate URLs for 16 profiles; the other 71 were not crawled. This bounded review is not comprehensive source discovery. Successful crawler responses do not imply matching, useful evidence. Quality gate and keep-index exceptions were unchanged. No publication, account changes, owner messages or indexing requests. Raw cached crawl responses remain under /tmp/dgc-crawl4ai-20261002/.

discoverySummary.interpretation: Searches were bounded discovery attempts, not exhaustive investigations. A name/location query can produce sparse or irrelevant results; absence of a verified source is not proof that no useful source exists. Only verified matching source content can support a promotion.

remainingDiscoveryOpportunities: Verify the possible ManJo identity behind Inactif using current owner-provided or accessible first-party evidence.
Verify current identity, location and a detailed service menu for The Cat’s Tail; directory contact details alone are insufficient.
Seek an accessible current grooming menu for Cally’s Clippers and Kennels; the municipal description is broad and its website link is Facebook.
Revisit two failed linked-site crawls if the sources become accessible; crawler failure is not proof that the business site is permanently unavailable.
For social-only and sparse-result profiles, use accessible primary evidence or owner-submitted details through the existing correction process. No owner contact was sent.
